content.short: Ada FromTheMine NFT is a digital art project about vivid ants, strolling around on the Cardano Blockchain.
content.description:
Hello, lovely people! ADA FROMTHEMINE NFT is a digital art project about vivid ants, strolling around on the Cardano Blockchain.

The 1000 ants from our latest series appear in 3D. They originate from 6 different tribes, each with its own sets of equipment. More details aswell as launch date will be announced in a few weeks. Every CNFT is unique. Our ants are here to bring ease and quirkiness to your life. The Ada FromTheMindWorld is vivid, colourful and an always developing. All started with our 2D series in autumn 2021, where we learned a lot about social media and the NFT market.

We found out that continuous work on our art and skills, as well as communication with our community, are essential. Since then we have been developing our digital art skills, which brought us to release 2 animations in the last month and now we are fully into 3D. Our 3D creation is currently being built and will be fully rigged, so they can move around in a 3D metaverse.

You can count on us, bringing lots of 3D fun to your life. Currently we are searching for a metaverse project to built an environment for the ants and already have a few promising contacts. Ada FromTheMine NFT - Christine and Daniel
